summary: Nine-metre loading-zone kerb on Moggill Road, too short for a van.
reasons: Only 9 m, under a van length

drivers.seclusion: Shops 3 m behind the footpath; a street tree and shopfronts overlook it.
drivers.access_and_room: Stretch is 9 m, shorter than a van, and ends at a driveway and tree.
drivers.convention: Loading zone and 2P signs apply on weekdays and Saturday morning; no overnight parking pattern.

sun_shade: Street tree shades the west half; open to the south sun.
